decisions.reason: The safety shoe line rests on the firm's core in-house manufacturing and development knowledge, so the firm can interpret market feedback and keep refining the models.
The comfort insole draws on existing foot-measurement and footwear expertise, but as a simple accessory that overlaps with other insoles it remains a candidate for consolidation.
The supportive insole builds on established ergonomic knowledge, though its overlap with the comfort and moulded insoles leaves some risk of being merged or replaced.
The ergonomic series combines core shoe competence with the firm's ergonomics development, giving it strong capacity to assimilate feedback and improve the line.
Firefighter boots extend the firm's protective-footwear materials and certification know-how, and the specialised niche justifies continued investment even though it requires distinct knowledge.
The flagship moulded insole integrates the firm's measurement tools, training services and footwear knowledge, making it strategically central and well supported by its absorptive capacity.
